chapter_title_en: Rising Winds Over the Sea – The Yin Demon Slash and the Six Extreme True Demons
chapter_seo_title: Han Li's Yin Demon Slash & Wen Tianren's Six Extreme True Demons - Chapter 582
chapter_meta_description: Han Li unveils the devastating Yin Demon Slash, severing Wen Tianren's arm. In retaliation, his opponent summons six powerful True Demon phantoms, forcing a clash of ultimate techniques in the Chaotic Star Sea!
og_title: A Life-or-Death Clash of Secret Arts!
og_description: Witness the power of the Yin Demon Slash and the legendary Six Extreme True Demon Art. The battle for survival in the stars takes a terrifying turn!
twitter_title: Han Li's Yin Demon Slash vs. the Six Extreme True Demons!
twitter_description: A brutal exchange of trump cards! Han Li severs a limb, only to face six summoned demonic phantoms. Who will survive this escalating duel?

lore_anchors.definition: A single-use, devastating attack cultivated by condensing a portion of one's vital essence. It is a banked trump card, representing immense potential power stored over a long period.
A demonic secret art that allows the user to sacrifice a pre-cultivated body part to negate an otherwise fatal blow. The body is treated as a consumable resource for survival.

Powerful demonic phantom projections summoned by the legendary Six Extreme True Demon Art, a top-tier technique in the Chaotic Star Sea. They can act independently and possess immense physical strength.
The unique, supreme lightning attribute of Han Li's magic treasure, exceptionally effective against evil and demonic entities, serving as a hard counter to many dark techniques.
